summary: The diff implements DataView.prototype.setInt32 as a thin wrapper over the shared `set_view_value` helper in crate::support::typed_array (not part of this diff). Step comments are kept above their code, step 2 defaults littleEndian to false when absent, step 3 propagates errors with `?`, and step 4 returns undefined. No test-specific branches, no swallowed errors, no fake return values, and no edits outside the file. The 14 remaining failures come from DataView.prototype.getInt32 being unimplemented (the tests use it to read back values), and the code reports that honestly through the helper. I could not inspect the helper itself, so the ToIndex/ToNumber ordering and the RangeError/TypeError checks in SetViewValue rely on that helper being correct. Its behaviour is only inferred from the 26 newly passing tests.
notes_for_next_attempt: The setInt32 wrapper looks spec-faithful. Verify that crate::support::typed_array::set_view_value performs SetViewValue steps 1-15 in order (RequireInternalSlot, ToIndex before ToNumber/ToBigInt, ToBoolean on littleEndian, IsViewOutOfBounds TypeError before the RangeError bound check, then SetValueInBuffer). The remaining 14 failures need DataView.prototype.getInt32 to be implemented before the setInt32 tests can pass fully.
